services.name: LEGOLAND® Hotel's Pontoon Boat Rides
services.desc: Come aboard for a relaxing, fun-filled family adventure around beautiful Lake Eloise and Lake Summit. Go on a guided historical wildlife tour of the “Famous Chain of Lakes” with one of our local tour guides. Your captain will cruise by the , the Esther Williams Florida Pool, and the LEGOLAND® Water Park while pointing out the wildlife such as: alligators, turtles, anhingas, ospreys, egrets, bald eagles, great blue herons and even otters! Your adventure will last approximately 25 minutes and can either be charged to your room as an amenity when booked or paid directly by the link provided or over the phone with a representative. services.name: 2 HR 4TH OF JULY SUNSET CRUISE W/FIREWORKS
services.desc: Our special 4th of July cruise! Rates Adults - $65 Children (ages 12 and under) - $55 Children (ages 3 and under) - free! Duration 2 hours About Sit back and relax on our plush seats as you take in a gorgeous sunset on peaceful Lake Howard. You will explore a minimum of seven to nine lakes, see plenty of wildlife and take in the sights of our stunning lakeside scenery. Watch the sun slowly dip behind our ancient cypress trees, catch a glimpse of the many species of birds as they head back to their resting place and the night-time regulars begin their day! Then head on over to Lake Eloise to experience the Legoland fireworks and end the night with a bang. Make your reservation today!

services.name: DAY TOUR W/STOP FOR LUNCH AT HARBORSIDE
services.desc: Spend the day on the chain of Lakes! This cruise is for those who would like to make a day of exploring the entire southern chain of Lakes in one day! Your cruise will depart at 10am and you will cruise for two hours starting at either Lake Summit or Lake Shipp depending on what day of the week your cruise is booked. Weekday cruises will start from Lake Summit and explore all the lakes on the southern portion of the tour first. Weekend cruises will start from Lake Shipp and begin with the northern lakes.
